urgent.heading: Bona ikliniki okanye isibhedlele ngokukhawuleza ukuba
urgent.primary_message: Uninzi lweefiva zabantwana aluyongozi. Kodwa ezi mpawu ziyatshintsha imeko — yiya ekliniki okanye esibhedlele.
red_flags: Usana olungaphantsi kweenyanga ezi-3 lunayo nayiphi na ifiva (38Â°C okanye ngaphezulu)
Ifiva engaphezu kwe-40Â°C kumntwana nakweyiphi na iminyaka
Intamo eqinileyo, intloko ebuhlungu kakhulu okanye ukunganyamezeli ukukhanya
Ukozela, kunzima ukumvusa okanye uthule ngendlela engaqhelekanga
Ukugabha okungapheliyo okanye akukho mchamo iiyure ezi-8 okanye ngaphezulu

what_is_it.heading: Ifiva ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Ifiva bubushushu bomzimba obungaphezu kwe-38Â°C. Ayisosifo — yindlela umzimba olwa ngayo nosulelo. Uninzi lweefiva zabantwana luyanceda kwaye aluyongozi ngokwalo.
paragraphs: Ifiva inceda amajoni omzimba asebenze nzima ngokuchasene neentsholongwane neebhaktiriya. Ubushushu ngokwalo aludli ngokulimaza umntwana — nokuba buphakame, abutshi ubuchopho (olu luloyiko oluqhelekileyo kodwa ayisiyiyo indlela ifiva eyenzakalisa ngayo umzimba). Okubalulekileyo kukuba ibangelwa yintoni kunye nokuba umntwana ubonakala njani.

Umntwana one-39Â°C kodwa ebonakala eqhelekile unokungakhathazi kangako kunomntwana one-38Â°C kodwa ethambile, engafuni ukutya okanye eziphatha ngendlela engaqhelekanga. Thembela kwindlela umntwana abonakala ngayo ngaphezu kwenani kwithemometha. Ukuba awuqinisekanga, mhlolise.

items.headline: Idla ngokuba Kulungile
items.body: Uninzi lweefiva zabantwana lubangelwa ziintsholongwane, luhlala iintsuku ezi-2–3, luze luphele ngaphandle konyango. Ifiva ngokwayo ayisoloko iyingxaki.

items.headline: Ngaphantsi kweenyanga ezi-3
items.body: Iintsana ezingaphantsi kweenyanga ezi-3 ezinayo nayiphi na ifiva zidinga ukuhlolwa ngokukhawuleza. Amajoni azo omzimba akakavuthwa kwaye usulelo lunokuba nzima.

items.headline: Jonga umntwana
items.body: Indlela umntwana abonakala ngayo naziphatha ngayo ibaluleke ngaphezu kwenani kwithemometha. Umntwana ophilayo onefiva ephezulu akakhathazi njengomntwana othambileyo onefiva ethambileyo.

items.headline: Akukho antibiotics
items.body: Ii-antibiotic azinyangi iintsholongwane. Uninzi lweefiva zabantwana lubangelwa ziintsholongwane — ii-antibiotic azincedi kwaye zinokubangela iziphumo ebezingalindelekanga.

pull_quote.text: Musa ukuleqa ithemometha. Jonga umntwana wakho. Umntwana odlala, osela, kwaye onamadiyapa amanzi wenza kakuhle — nokuba ifiva iphezulu. Umntwana othambileyo, onamehlo angakhanyi, udinga uncedo — nokuba ifiva ithambile.

signs.heading: Ungazi njani ukuba inzima
signs.lede: Ifiva ngokwayo ayisiyiyo ingozi. Jonga umfanekiso wonke — indlela umntwana aziphatha ngayo, ukuphefumla, ulwelo kunye nezinye iimpawu.

items.title: Mhlawumbi kulungile
items.description: Umntwana uyaphendula (uyadlala, uyancuma, uyabukela), usela ulwelo, unamadiyapa amanzi, akukho rhashalala, akukho ngxaki yokuphefumla. Ifiva ingaba phezulu kodwa umntwana ubonakala njengesiqhelo.

items.title: Jonga ngononophelo
items.description: Umntwana uthule ngokungaqhelekanga, akadlali njengesiqhelo, akatyi kakuhle, ifiva ihlala iiyure ezingama-24–48, urhashalala ethambileyo. Ayisiyongxamiseko kodwa kufanelekile ukuya ekliniki ukuba iyaqhubeka okanye iba mandundu.

items.title: Fumana uncedo ngoku
items.description: Umntwana uthambile okanye akaphenduli, uphefumla ngokukhawuleza okanye ngomzamo, urhashalala engapheliyo phantsi kweglasi, intamo eqinileyo, wala lonke ulwelo, akukho mchamo iiyure ezi-8 okanye ngaphezulu, ukuxhuzula, okanye naluphi na usana olungaphantsi kweenyanga ezi-3 olunayo nayiphi na ifiva.

items.title: Mncedise anxibe kancinci — gcina igumbi likhululekile
items.description: Impahla elula, ingubo elula ukuba uyangcangcazela. Musa ukumgquma ngeengubo ezinzima okanye ukumsongele — oku kunyusa ubushushu bomzimba ngakumbi.

items.title: Nikeza ulwelo rhoqo
items.description: Ubisi lwebele, ifomula, amanzi, i-ORS. Iimali ezincinci, rhoqo. Jonga amadiyapa amanzi — luphawu lokuba unamanzi aneleyo.

items.title: I-paracetamol okanye i-ibuprofen kuphela ukuze akhululeke
items.description: Hayi ngenxa yenani kwithemometha — kuphela ukuba umntwana ubonakala engonwabanga. Landela idosi esekelwe kubunzima ebhotileni. Musa ukudibanisa i-paracetamol ne-ibuprofen ngaphandle kwengcebiso yezonyango.

items.title: Musa ukumhlamba ngamanzi abandayo okanye ngotywala
items.description: Oku akukhululekanga kwaye kungabangela ukungcangcazela, nto leyo enyusa ubushushu. Amanzi afudumeleyo kancinci alungile ukuba umntwana uyawafuna.

items.title: Thembela kwimvakalelo yakho
items.description: Ukuba kukho into evakala ingalunganga — nokuba awukwazi ukuyichaza — yiya ekliniki. Abazali babona utshintsho oluncinci olubalulekileyo. Abasebenzi bezempilo bakhetha ukuba uzise umntwana kungenanto kunokuba baphoswe yinto.

get_help.heading: Apho omawuye khona
get_help.lede: Uninzi lweefiva zabantwana lunokulawulwa ekhaya. Ukwazi ukuba nini ukunyusa inqanaba lolona lwazi lubalulekileyo — kwaye iikliniki ziyakwamkela abazali abakhathazekileyo.
